name: vaws-top
note: vaws-top is consumed as an external checkout, not a submodule and not a vendored copy. The scaffold locates the checkout through VAWS_TOP_ROOT, --clone-dir, or the documented default path above. Bump `commit` deliberately after root refreshes the published main; missing pins fail closed instead of running unpinned. The extracted monitor owns its runtime and advanced skill; this consumer only locates/bootstraps the local loopback service and hands off to that skill. Observation records are not NPU allocation authority.
